description: What employers offer a rank in vacancies on Rynda Crewing: median monthly pay in USD and the middle half of the range (25th to 75th percentile), each with the number of vacancies and companies behind it, the typical contract, the report period, and how many vacancies of the rank are open now. These are employer offers, not seafarer expectations.
name: get_salary_by_rank
title: Salary by rank
